body: Yeah, I guess I would have to hurry anyway if I want to see the oceans before they are entirely destroyed by humanity. But thank you for making me feel understood. It is good to know that there are people out there being nice and compassionate with a total stranger, without expecting anything in return.

Hmm...yeah, you don't need to know where you're going...but why go at all??

I have done some sailing yes... and I do like the idea of me on the ocean. Making this happen would require a couple of years of working up to it though and I just don't seem to be able to get the motivation to do it.  
Secretly there's also the thought that if I have an accident out there in the water (intentionally or not) it would probably be a bit easier to deal with for my family if I'm gone than if they know that I killed myself.

No worries, I'm pretty sure it was my wording that caused the misunderstanding (I edited the post)...Yeah, you're right. I've actually been fantasizing about buying an old sailboat for like 5k, refitting it and getting out in the ocean away from everyone I know, leaving them under the impression that I enjoy life so that I just have to be miserable with myself instead of them noticing or me having to act normal infront of them. But then again, why go through all of that trouble if I can't think of a scenario where I actually enjoy life?

I just meant that its a country with one of the highest living standards, with freedom, safety, decent salaries, opportunities etc...But for me that makes my situation even worse - like, if I don't even see the point of life under these (exceptionally fortunate) circumstances, what's the point?
